svg.title: Sonogashira coupling: Copper-assisted alkyne activation
svg.desc: HC≡CPh + Cu(I) halide + amine → Copper phenylacetylide ensemble + ammonium halide. Copper-assisted deprotonation/aggregation activates the terminal alkyne. An amine alone is not asserted to quantitatively generate free acetylide.

g.text: Process model: no unique microscopic electron-arrow sequence asserted.
